line_values: Explicit byte-bound preimage origin numbers; diagnostic tracking metadata, not silently described as postimage physical line numbers. Rebase requires root-authorized origin-data rebinding.
original_file_argument: __FILE__ evaluated in the actual C consumer translation unit; static storage retained
post_cleanup_untouched: ret test, IRQsave/runq lock/runq_irqstate/preempt_enable/contextswitch and -EFAULT if switch returns are entirely unchanged; no preemption/lock behavior moved.
preexisting_ownership: desc allocated before every goto end; failed descriptor allocation returns earlier. envp/argv may be NULL, successful flatten allocations are owned, distinct and no longer read after cleanup. Descriptor always released4pages/kernel0.
scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
